newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen fluctating on liquidity woes.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen fluctating on liquidity woes.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to fluctuate on lingering concerns about more corporate liquidity troubles but steadily rising cutomers deposits helped sooth investors' sentiment, brokers said on Monday.

Casey Choe at Union Bank of Swtizerland said the market would watch developments from the bail-out committee by financial institutions. "The committee is expected to come up with measures to cushion off its side-effects. If the committee does so, this will be favourable news for the market."
The composite stock index closed on Saturday at 725.17, down 5.36 points.
Brokers said customers deposits with brokerage houses stood at 3.3 trillion won, enough to boost investors' sentiment.
They forecast a tug-of-war around the 720-730 level to soak up selling pressure.
Banking shares are expected to fluctuate on anticipation of an increase in the individual ownership ceiling in banks.
